description: This file contains a PHP class '_parse_lockinfo' designed to parse LOCK request bodies in WebDAV protocol, reading XML input from a stream and extracting lock type, scope, and owner information.

classes.name: _parse_lockinfo
classes.description: Helper class for parsing LOCK request bodies in WebDAV, extracting lock type, scope, and owner information from XML input.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser, reads XML input from a file stream, and extracts lock information.

methods.name: _startElement
methods.description: Handles the start of an XML element, sets lock type and scope, and collects owner info.

methods.name: _data
methods.description: Handles character data within XML, used to accumulate owner information.

methods.name: _endElement
methods.description: Handles the end of an XML element, finalizes owner data collection.
